about: Oneway's changelog (founder/870): one entry per big update, newest first. date is the day (YYYY-MM-DD); words are the founder's. An entry may also have a title and sections, each a title and a list of items (founder/1024). A line marked as pending is not live yet: tools/landing_static.py leaves it out of the published page and file until the mark is cleared. changelog.html is drawn from this file; adding an entry needs no change to the page.

entries.title: v50
entries.words: A big update across Oneway: new safety tools, more privacy choices, and new things in the App and for businesses.

sections.title: Safety and security
items: Layered protection for your account and every sign-in.
Harmful posts, comments and messages are stopped before anyone sees them, and community reports are acted on quickly.
Oneway spots and stops attacks automatically, such as spam floods and password guessing.
Our team's safety tools keep Oneway protected around the clock.
An intimate picture shared without consent can be taken down fast, with every copy.

sections.title: Privacy
items: Choose who sees when you are online.
Choose how comments with strong words appear to you: shown, blurred or hidden, and keep your own list of hidden words.
An edited post says Edited, and you decide whether people can see the original.
Extra care for teens, including a location shared only with friends.
You can change your birthday once in Settings.

sections.title: New in the App
items: Edit your profile or your Center's page right where you are, with drafts and history.
Place anything anywhere on your page.
The Marketplace: list an item, meet buyers nearby, and get safe meetup suggestions.
Every post on Home shows its author's own colour.
Discovery's map turns like Apple Maps, with the places near you as cards.
A faster Home, and every screen stays where you left it.
Twelve month colours, smoother light and dark mode, and a new icon set.

sections.title: For Centers and businesses
items: Book a table or a room right on a Center's website.
Tickets, events and rewards work together, with a simple 1% fee.
Arrange a Center's pages into tidy categories.
Choose exactly which Facebook Page, Instagram account or Google listing you connect.
A new home screen in Oneway OS.

sections.title: The website
items: The landing's headline line is new, Oneway OS is marked coming soon on the Business OS pages and every System page, and the footer has a Discovery page and this changelog.

entries.words: Discovery became its own app inside Oneway, with Waypass and Near here. Messages, notifications and team chat were rebuilt, profiles got one clean layout, Lightbulb got a new camera and drafts, and the App and the OS can now be opened and closed from oneway.center itself.
Platform servers have been put live for the first time, and the first App and landing tests began with pleasant results. We have already started work on the next fix to make Oneway even better.
